Hi Anna / Hydronix AP team —

Following our conversation last week, quick proposal to simplify October settlement: Redwood can group outstanding invoices dated Sep 20–30 into a single Oct 6 batched payment. That reduces payment overhead on your side and keeps our AR cadence aligned with your payroll run.

Options for payment method:
- Virtual card (preferred if you can accept — we’ll provide a single-line item CVV/expiry and a Card Processing memo)
- ACH micro-test + full ACH on Oct 6
- Wire on Oct 6 (we can provide same-day remittance stub)

I attached a one-tab schedule (OCT-BATCH-SCHEDULE.xlsx) showing the invoices we plan to include and the requested cutoffs. If you choose virtual card we’ll mark the invoices as "card-approved" and issue the payment link Tuesday Oct 5. If ACH/wire, please confirm remit account and VAT entity to ensure correct tax reporting.

Key asks:
1) Confirm which payment method you prefer by EOD Oct 4
2) Confirm PO number to reference on the remittance (if applicable)

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 15m call if that helps.

Best,
Marissa Cole

(415) 555-0189
